message: A behavioral break the corpus exercises is no longer being caught by the differ. CI cannot see this: `compatlab score` gates on every breaking finding having a hand verdict, not on recall, so a break that stops being detected leaves the build green. Read the newest run on the quality trend page, then `uv run --group evals python -m evals --case detection-recall`. RC1-611. @webhook-incident-summarizer
name: API Compatibility Lab — a documented break went undetected
